data: In which clusters are X symbols located?

The X symbols are located in the following clusters:

1. Red cluster (PER): There is an X symbol near the center of the red cluster.
2. Orange cluster (MISC): There is an X symbol in the middle of the orange cluster.
3. Blue cluster (ORG): There is an X symbol in the lower part of the blue cluster.
4. Green cluster (LOC): There is an X symbol in the upper part of the green cluster.

These X symbols represent delexicalized entities, which are entities without specific labels or categories.
